[list] [*][b]1855 Pieces:[/b] Build various environments of this mega BUNKER, such as the dormitory, control room, gym, and even the exterior, with its exploration bus.

notes.title: RELEASE date announcement + super pre-launch DISCOUNT for Diorama Builder
notes.content:
[h2]From 13 to 19/06 with 60% discount, before the price increase[/h2]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/35020302/9b1124ee0d5c8688d9e79686fa2a76c0f81cc649.png[/img]

[u][b]Hello fellow Diorama builders[/b][/u]

The wait is almost over - the release of the final version of "[u][b]Diorama Builder[/b][/u]" arrives on [u][b]June 20, 2024[/b][/u]! Mark your calendars and get ready to dive into an even more complete diorama-building experience, including the 3 DLCs that will be released on the same day.

[h2]SUPER DISCOUNT OF 60% PRE-LAUNCH OF "DIORAMA BUILDER"[/h2]

For those who are POSTPONING the purchase of DIORAMA BUILDER and in the name of transparency, we will be increasing the price for the LAUNCH of the FINAL VERSION, so to encourage them, between the 13th and 19th of May 2024, we will give a super discount of 60%!

[h3][b]>>> Don't miss this opportunity, BUY Diorama Builder now! <<<[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1370170/Diorama_Builder/

[h2]WHAT'S NEW IN THE FINAL VERSION?[/h2]

We've been working hard to polish and perfect Diorama Builder, and we're excited to reveal a host of new features and improvements in the final release:
[list]
[*][u][b] Catalog of native dioramas and DLCs[/b][/u]
Easily browse and manage your collection of dioramas (including the DLCs).

[*][u][b] Shelf organization system[/b][/u]
Keep your diorama shelf organized and stocked with the dioramas you like most and are currently assembling.

[*][u][b] Stamps to divide the different dioramas into categories[/b][/u]
Presentation of a SEAL for each diorama, determining its series for better identification.

[*][u][b] Axis visual system for better camera control[/b][/u]
A new system to locate the center of the XYZ axes and thus be able to have greater control of the camera (rotation and zoom) at the desired point or object.

[*][u][b] Option to hide/show Diorama pieces from any folder[/b][/u]
Turn on/off the visibility of diorama folders (parts) for a more focused view.

[*][u][b] New system for going down and up certain walls (for dioramas with this feature)[/b][/u]
Move down and up certain walls of the dioramas with this feature, in a simpler and more intuitive way, to better appreciate the diorama's internal spaces.

[*][u][b] News feed[/b][/u]
Stay up to date on the latest news and announcements from Diorama Builder.

[*][u][b] Improved help system[/b][/u]
Find assistance quickly and easily with the improved help system.

[*][u][b] Visual, UI, and UX improvements[/b][/u]
Experience improved visuals and a smoother, more intuitive user experience.

[*][u][b] Performance Improvements[/b][/u]
Enjoy more stable and responsive gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]ABOUT THE DLCS[/h2]

Expand your diorama collection with the DLCs that will come out with the final version.
Don't leave it for later, add them to your WISHLIST now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2777580/Diorama_Builder__Noir_City/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668590/Diorama_Builder__Medieval_Castle/

[quote]NEW DLC TO BE ANNOUNCED SOON AND RELEASED TOGETHER WITH THE FINAL VERSION OF THE GAME[/quote]

Thank you and follow our page to stay up to date with upcoming announcements and news!
https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/virtualartsstudio

All the best, to everyone, always!

notes.title: "The Awakening of Mummies" is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/abf4d0d3b36f9a54fb66d897c950fb75394997c4.png[/img]

Hi friends,

We are proudly launching yet another game, a game designed to amuse and challenge your logical and visual reasoning.

Using your puzzle-solving skills, guide all mummies through various chambers full of traps to finally set them free from the evil Pharaoh Cléo.

[h2]How to help these Mummies escape:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Control all the Mummies together, that is, by moving them in a certain direction, they all will too.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/f28396c90f914751e462b2897eeed8778959d9b5.gif[/img]

[*] Make sure that each mummy takes the corresponding staff before going to the Totem of the same color, as this is the only way the Portal will open.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/076b405dc5cfaa90cfc1ec351d6af37af6d53826.gif[/img]

[*][u][b] Take care with:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Holes: It is death for sure.
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/f1f75a6e9455d2e938370a25b1a83b3b8d836cba.gif[/img]

[*] Spears: It is not good to be pricked!
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/3b4959149553e2f47df67a3b4cece323d8762df7.gif[/img]
[/list]

[*][u][b] Keep an eye:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Broken Floor: Nothing can happen, but be careful!
[*] Magic Mist: Get the crown, otherwise the cumin will be uncertain and the end almost certain.
[*] Mud: She will delay you, but it can help you.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Play it NOW...[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593410/The_Awakening_of_Mummies/

notes.title: Diorama Builder - Christmas 2020 Update
UPDATE 1.10
notes.content:
[b][u]Dear MAGICOLORS players:[/u][/b]

Since the launch, we have received several requests for the inclusion and modification of the game's features, so we decided to bring this NEW UPDATE.
We carefully analyzed all requests and selected those that we really felt would be an addition to the game and that fit the concept and sensations that we wanted to convey to the players.
These changes are as follows:

[olist]
[*] The TOP-DOWN view is no longer deactivated after the Mage moves or fires a spell, now it only occurs when the player wants;
[*]  We introduced the WINDOWED mode, allowing the player also be able to play in this mode and not just in FULL-SCREEN mode anymore;
[*]  The mouse wheel can now be used to rotate the stage and the middle mouse button to switch between TOP-DOWN and 3RD PERSON VIEW.
[/olist]
We also solved some BUGs and interface problems.
We thank you all for the excellent suggestions and we hope you enjoy this UPDATE.
We look forward to your comments at COMMUNITY CENTER.

Get fun!

Ah, and also we´ll like to inform you about our new game that will be released in a few weeks! That's "SMIB: Mission Cure", where you need remotely program SMIB (your robot) in an adventure through the most exotic planets in the Universe, solving puzzles to find the cure to the humankind.

Don't forget to put it in your [u][b]WISHLIST[/b][/u], ok?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1300060/SMIB_Mission_Cure/

notes.title: MAGICOLORS update Version 1.02
notes.content:
[u][b]Dear players:[/b][/u]

We're releasing an update to MAGICOLORS, version 1.02, as we detected an error that caused the "Ending the Journey" achievement to be released early in the game.
This fix, in addition to solving the problem, also eliminates the conquest of those players who have NOT really finished the game.
Thank you all for your understanding, feedback, and support.
